caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular woven or stitched textile piece with multicolored patterns. The central motif consists of three large, symmetrical, rounded shapes arranged horizontally, each resembling a four-petaled flower. These shapes are primarily outlined in black and are filled with concentric layers of color, including shades of red, cream, blue, and green. The background behind the central motifs is composed of irregular, wavy layers of beige, blue, brown, and gray tones. The border of the textile features a braided or twisted pattern with an alternating color scheme of red, blue, and cream. The textile is set against a neutral beige background, and the name "Charles Goodwin" is written in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Shaker Rug
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
